# Logger.log() method

Logs to the console and to every configured transport.

**Signature:**

```typescript
log(...args: any[]): void;
```

**Returns:**

void

## Remarks

Reaches transports at winston's `info` level — there is no distinct `log` level — so records from here and from [Logger.info()](/api/async-logger/latest/async-logger.logger.info/) are indistinguishable once shipped. They differ only in the console method used. Pick by the destination you care about.
